Test Description: Verify that the homepage loads successfully.
Check that the navigation bar displays all expected links (Home, Explore, Upload, Profile, etc.).
Expected Result: Navigation bar shows all required links.

Test Description: Ensure the search bar is visible and functional.
Expected Result: Search bar is present and accepts input.

Test Description: Test that clicking on a track starts playback.
Verify that the play/pause button works as expected.
Expected Result: Audio toggles between play and pause.

Test Description: Check that the progress bar updates as the track plays.
Expected Result: Progress bar moves as audio plays.

Test Description: Ensure volume control adjusts the audio output.
Expected Result: Volume changes as slider is moved.

Test Description: Verify that a list of tracks is displayed on the main page.
Expected Result: Track list is visible with multiple tracks.

Test Description: Check that clicking a track opens its detail page/modal.
Expected Result: Track detail page/modal opens with info.

Test Description: Ensure track details (title, artist, duration, cover art) are displayed correctly.
Expected Result: All track details are shown accurately.

Test Description: Test that users can like/favorite a track.
Verify that users can follow/unfollow artists.
Check that users can upload a new track (if upload is supported on frontend).
Expected Result: Track upload UI works and shows success.

Test Description: Ensure searching for a track/artist returns relevant results.
Test filtering tracks by genre, popularity, or upload date.
Expected Result: Track list updates according to filter.

Test Description: Verify the app layout adapts correctly to different screen sizes (desktop, tablet, mobile).
Expected Result: Layout adjusts and remains usable on all devices.

Test Description: Check that an error message is shown if a track fails to load.
Expected Result: User sees a clear error message.

Test Description: Ensure the app handles missing or broken images gracefully.
Expected Result: Default or placeholder image is shown.
